The '''Imperial Palace Guard''' was a division of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]] tasked with guarding the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. During the first [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial Palace Guard was the first display unit in the [[Shaldania Parade|traditional parade]].
